metaTitle: How Long a Power Station Runs a 12V Fridge
description: Estimate how many hours or days a portable power station can run a 12V compressor fridge, with duty cycle tables, DC versus AC tips and solar sizing.
directAnswer: A 12V compressor fridge typically uses 250 to 500 Wh a day, so a 500 Wh power station runs one for one to two days and a 1,000 Wh unit for two to three. Use the DC port and shade the fridge to stretch it.
